summary: The diff implements Math.log10 in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/math/log10.rs and nothing else. Steps 1 to 6 follow the spec in order. ToNumber is called via ops::to_number with `?`, so abrupt completions propagate. NaN and +Infinity return n. 1 returns +0. Both zeros return -Infinity. Values below -0 (including -Infinity) return NaN. Everything else returns f64::log10, which the spec permits as an approximation. Each step has its spec comment directly above it. The only changed file is the one in scope. The branches test spec conditions rather than specific test inputs. I did not check that ops::to_number exists under that name, but the gate reports the build as ok.
